data.description: Smoke constantly drifts from a kapre's mouth, and as a standard action it can exhale a 30-foot cone of smoke. Any creature in the area must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1 round. This is a poison effect.
data.name: Blow Smoke
